card.name: Historical dates and events
card.fires_on: Digits inside year numbers (the 9 in 1918, 1941, 1933, the 8 in 1087) and words in short history narration about ancient or early modern figures. It appears in history texts about Archimedes, Hitler, Columbus and Aristotle.

modes.label: Digits inside years
modes.description: A middle digit of a four-digit year, mostly 20th-century or medieval dates in history writing.

modes.label: Verbs and links in historical accounts
modes.description: A verb, preposition or possessive in a sentence recounting what a historical figure did.
modes.example: Columbus departed on his first voyage<< from>> the port of Palos in southern Spain

card.writes: It promotes odd rare tokens and suppresses words like classical and Classic, so there is no clear effect on the next word beyond avoiding classical-era terms.
card.plain: It fires on history writing, especially on the middle digits of years like 1918 or 1941.
